mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above 4% for two consecutive months predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days due to tightened policy expectations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% and remains >4% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window following the trigger, SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the pre-trigger average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly UNRATE falls below 4%, labor market slack increases and equity risk premia decline, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In 20-day windows where UNRATE < 4%, forward returns are not positive (mean < 0) or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the monthly GDPC1 personal consumption expenditure (quarterly log growth > 0.5%) indicates accelerating demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 5 days following the trigger, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly INDPRO supply index falls below 104 (2017=100), it signals an oversupply condition that compresses valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In 20-day periods after INDPRO crosses below 104, forward returns are not negative or the effect is not robust to out-of-sample testing (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in both FEDFUNDS and HOUST (industrial production) above their prior month's values indicate a dual signal of policy easing and strong demand, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > previous month AND HOUST > previous month
failure_condition: In 60-day windows with the trigger, SPX 20-day forward returns are not positive or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in PAYEMS (labor market activity) by more than 10% in a month predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days as market participants anticipate stronger hiring.
failure_condition: In 20-day windows following the trigger, forward returns are not positive or the effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly RSAFS (residential supply) exceeds 700 billion dollars for two consecutive months, it suggests a supply-rich environment that is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Over 60 days with the trigger, forward returns are not negative or the interaction effect is not robust (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime where CPIAUCSL monthly inflation exceeds 2% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to deliver negative forward returns over the next 20 days as investors anticipate tighter policy.
failure_condition: In 20-day windows after the trigger, SPX 20-day forward returns are not negative or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
